quotes.text:
import:
    type: event
    description: >
      Records each time about:import is used to import a profile, calendar
      entries, or address book entries.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1942711
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1942711
    data_sensitivity:
      - interaction
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never
    extra_keys:
      importer:
        description: >
          Which import module was used to import the data. For profiles, this
          also includes where the profile was imported from - the other
          application's profile files, an arbitrary directory, or zip file.
        type: string
      types:
        description: >
          The types of data imported. For profiles, these are the options
          selected in the UI. For other data, this is the format of the file
          that was imported.
        type: string
      result:
        description: Success or failure.
        type: string

  notification_enabled_actions:

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Profile import builds importer metadata with zip, profile or directory and records unzipFailed separately from failed. It records succeeded after the backend startImport resolves and then updates the finish UI. Address-book and calendar imports also record their own importer/result values after awaiting backend work. Preserve these result stages when extending this event. The schema and success-test metadata were inspected; data review, failure events and remote telemetry were not validated. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.
title: Import telemetry records the stage that completed or failed
